item.title: NSFW Acronyms for Programmers (Free eBook)

Junior developers trying to avoid painful rookie mistakes Mid-level devs drowning in process theater Senior engineers who’ve seen things and are tired of pretending otherwise Why this book exists Most programming advice is: Over-sanitized Over-abstracted Under-tested in the real world This book exists to say the quiet parts out loud — with humor, clarity, and zero corporate polish.
